dedupe_keys.name: kit nmc silicon anode battery ageing results and logs

description: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology publishes ageing observations from 228 commercial NMC cells with carbon and silicon-oxide anodes. The experimental coverage includes calendar ageing, cycling and driving profiles, with capacity, impedance and pulse-resistance results plus measurement logs. The second release extends the campaign to nearly 600 days and separates results from logs. RADAR4KIT provides both parts free under CC BY 4.0. The collection can calibrate battery-degradation simulations and storage-lifetime assumptions used in model-pypsa planning. A caveat is that the original impedance archive omitted some cells; a linked addendum supplies the complete set. Users should select a consistent release, not mix original and extended records. Nominal operating settings do not capture every changing cell condition. No measurement archive was downloaded or model fitted.
